title: Implementation of the Habegger--Lin decision algorithm
summary: Habegger and Lin gave a classification of link-homotopy classes of links in terms of that of string links modulo certain group actions. As an application, they constructed an algorithm for determining whether given two links are link-homotopic. In \cite{KM4}, we explicitly computed these group actions for the 4- and 5-component cases. Consequently, the Habegger--Lin algorithm can be effectively applied in these cases.
